title: ECMA-376 Style Cascade, Numbering Lists & Section Geometry

vectors.name: DocDefaults Resolution
vectors.description: Validates default run and paragraph properties resolution from w:docDefaults.
vectors.input: DocDefaults with font Calibri 22pt (11pt), color 333333, line spacing 240, after spacing 120.

vectors.name: Paragraph Style Inheritance Chain
vectors.description: Validates multi-level paragraph style inheritance via w:basedOn chains.
vectors.input: Base paragraph style -> Derived paragraph style with partial overrides.

vectors.name: Character Style Inheritance Chain
vectors.description: Validates character style inheritance chain via w:basedOn.
vectors.input: Base character style (sz=24, color=FF0000) -> Derived character style (italic=true).

vectors.name: Cyclic BasedOn Style Safety
vectors.description: Verifies cycle detection and termination in circular w:basedOn chains (A -> B -> A).
vectors.input: Style A basedOn B, Style B basedOn A.

vectors.name: Direct Paragraph Formatting Override
vectors.description: Validates that direct w:pPr overrides style and docDefaults formatting.
vectors.input: Paragraph style (jc=left, space_after=100) with direct w:pPr (jc=right, space_after=200).

vectors.name: Direct Run Formatting Override
vectors.description: Validates that direct w:rPr overrides character and paragraph styles.
vectors.input: Character style (color=00FF00, sz=28) with direct w:rPr (color=0000FF, sz=36).

vectors.name: Toggle Property Bold Inversion
vectors.description: Validates ECMA-376 §17.7.3 toggle property bold inversion on direct formatting.
vectors.input: Bold in style: true, direct w:b: inverted to false; Bold in style: false, direct w:b: inverted to true.

vectors.name: Toggle Property Italic Inversion
vectors.description: Validates ECMA-376 §17.7.3 toggle property italic inversion on direct formatting.
vectors.input: Italic in style: true, direct w:i: inverted to false; Italic in style: false, direct w:i: inverted to true.

vectors.name: Toggle Property Strike Inversion
vectors.description: Validates ECMA-376 §17.7.3 toggle property strikethrough inversion on direct formatting.
vectors.input: Strike in style: true, direct w:strike: inverted to false; Strike in style: false, direct w:strike: inverted to true.

vectors.name: Table Style Whole Table Resolution
vectors.description: Validates whole table formatting resolution from w:tblStylePr type='wholeTable'.
vectors.input: Table style with wholeTable shd=F0F0F0 and bold=false.

vectors.name: Table Style First Row Override
vectors.description: Validates conditional table formatting for first row (header) cells.
vectors.input: Table style with firstRow override bold=true, color=FFFFFF, shd=003366.

vectors.name: Table Style Last Row Override
vectors.description: Validates conditional table formatting for last row (total) cells.
vectors.input: Table style with lastRow override bold=true, shd=E0E0E0.

vectors.name: Table Style Horizontal Banding
vectors.description: Validates alternating row shading from band1Horz conditional table formatting.
vectors.input: Table style with band1Horz shd=FAFAFA on alternating rows.

vectors.name: Table Style Vertical Banding
vectors.description: Validates alternating column shading from band1Vert conditional table formatting.
vectors.input: Table style with band1Vert shd=F5F5F5 on alternating columns.

vectors.name: Table Style Corner Cell Overrides
vectors.description: Validates corner cell conditional overrides: nwCell, neCell, swCell, seCell.
vectors.input: Table style with nwCell and seCell distinct shading colors.

vectors.name: Numbering Decimal Format
vectors.description: Validates standard decimal counter formatting (1, 2, 3, ...).
vectors.input: Sequence of 5 items with numFmt='decimal'.

vectors.name: Numbering Lower Letter Format
vectors.description: Validates lower-case alphabetical counter formatting (a, b, ..., z, aa, ab, ...).
vectors.input: Counter values 1, 2, 26, 27, 28 with numFmt='lowerLetter'.

vectors.name: Numbering Upper Letter Format
vectors.description: Validates upper-case alphabetical counter formatting (A, B, ..., Z, AA, AB, ...).
vectors.input: Counter values 1, 2, 26, 27 with numFmt='upperLetter'.

vectors.name: Numbering Lower Roman Format
vectors.description: Validates lower-case Roman numeral counter formatting (i, iv, v, ix, x, xl, l, xc, c, cd, d, cm, m).
vectors.input: Values 1, 4, 9, 14, 40, 90, 400, 900, 1994 with numFmt='lowerRoman'.

vectors.name: Numbering Upper Roman Format
vectors.description: Validates upper-case Roman numeral counter formatting.
vectors.input: Values 1, 4, 9, 14, 2024 with numFmt='upperRoman'.

vectors.name: Numbering Bullet Format
vectors.description: Validates bullet glyph format constant string output.
vectors.input: Level template with bullet character '•' (U+2022) and numFmt='bullet'.

vectors.name: Numbering Ordinal Format
vectors.description: Validates English ordinal number suffix formatting (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 11th, 21st).
vectors.input: Values 1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 21, 22, 23, 101 with numFmt='ordinal'.

vectors.name: Numbering Cardinal Text Format
vectors.description: Validates English cardinal number words (one, twelve, twenty-one).
vectors.input: Values 1, 12, 25, 105 with numFmt='cardinalText'.

vectors.name: Multi-Level List Template Interpolation
vectors.description: Validates multi-level list template placeholder substitution (%1.%2.%3).

vectors.name: Multi-Level List Hybrid Formatting
vectors.description: Validates hybrid formatting across levels (Upper Roman -> Upper Letter -> Decimal).
vectors.input: Level 0 (upperRoman): %1., Level 1 (upperLetter): %1.(%2), Level 2 (decimal): %1.(%2).%3.

vectors.name: Numbering Level Restart on Parent Increment
vectors.description: Validates child level counter resets to start value when parent level increments.
vectors.input: Parent 1 -> Child 1, Child 2 -> Parent 2 -> Child (should restart at 1).

vectors.name: Numbering Level Override Start
vectors.description: Validates w:lvlOverride / w:startOverride overriding starting number counter.
vectors.input: Instance numId overriding level 0 start to 5.

vectors.name: Section Geometry Margins and Content Box
vectors.description: Validates SectionGeometry page dimensions, margins, and content box computation in twips.
vectors.input: Page 12240 x 15840 twips (US Letter), top=1440, bottom=1440, left=1440, right=1440.

vectors.name: Section Multi-Column Division
vectors.description: Validates multi-column layout division with equal and unequal column widths and spacing.
vectors.input: Content width 9360 twips, 3 columns, spacing 360 twips.

vectors.name: Section Geometry Unit Conversions
vectors.description: Validates bidirectional conversions between twips, points, inches, and millimeters.
vectors.input: 1440 twips = 72 pt = 1.0 inch = 25.4 mm.

vectors.name: WordPackage Styles Round-Trip
vectors.description: Validates WordPackage parses styles.xml into StyleSheet DOM, preserves it, and serializes accurately.
vectors.input: baseline.docx open -> parse styles -> serialize -> reload.

vectors.name: Subphase 3.1.2 Test Vectors Manifest Validation
vectors.description: Asserts synchronization between test suite and evidence vector manifest with >= 30 vectors.
vectors.input: specs/evidence/word/3.1.2_vectors.json.
